balls.text: Still no runs off bat in this over, will he bowl a last-over maiden? Will he ever, another yorker, Teja is right in front of this yorker, Dharmasena thinks long and hard and raises his finger. A double-wicket maiden to finish it off. Malinga you beauty
that's cruel, full, late inswinging yorker, Teja has no clue, it hits his pad, and moves to right of keeper for four
another yorker, and how did that miss? pitched inches in front of off stump, and cut away to miss the stump, and beats Pinal too, one bye
who Malinga, slower bopuncer, who would have thought, it's an offcutter too, 116ks, and it beats Ojha's poke

Slinga to slinga, see you later, Edwards makes room, but a perfect yourler comes out, low trajectory, headed for the base of the middle stump. Even a specialist batsman would have been incredibly proud had he got a single off this one
and he tries to bounce fellow-slinger Fidel Edwards. Fidel is surprised, and sways out of line
on the pads, slower, and Teja just amanages a chip towards long-leg
fired in this time, on leg stump, no room for batsman, just a single to long-on
and Harbhajan fools RP this time, RP looked for a big shot again, stepped out, Harbhajan tossed it up again, RP was clearly early into the shot, and ended up lobbing it to cover
tossed up again, slow-swept, but the field is set for that shot, will be just one
full and flat this, driven away into covers
RP looks to slog after stepping out, Harbhajan slows it up, and RP chips it over midwicket
full and wide, Teja looks to drive, but can't beat cover
fulltoss, and RP hits it towards long-off
Malinga didn't need Sachin for this one. Yorker, on the leg, fast, Venu has no reply, tries to save the toe, which he does, but the ball takes the pad, and hits the base of leg
dropped, by Sachin, slower ball, Venu mis-hits, Sachin runs back from midwicket, but the ball pops out. Dififcult chance that, running backwards
there's a bit of Dhoni, inswinging yorker, but Venu takes it out of the hole, and flicks it over midwicket
flat, fast, on the stumps, Teja gets a single to point
slower ball, outside off, and Teja opens the face for a single
good nudge, will get four, just outside four, fullish, and sliced away just wide of keeper
Venu almost involved in another run-out. Fullish, swiped away towards long-on, and Teja wants two, Venu doesn't. Teja has to go back from half way, and the throw is just a bit wide, which saves him
ties the slower offcutter, pitches leg, cuts in, and Venu lets it go
short and wide, but slower, so Venu is early into the cut, and can't get enough power
full, on the pads, and turned away by Teja
Bravo tries the bouncer again, this is a slower one too, and Venu looks to upper-cut, but is beaten by the case, still manages to lob it over keeper
on the pads, and turned away for one
off cutter, and and Venu is beaten outside off

oh what an error, Mumbai are right back, Gibb s had stepped out to york himself, and play it towards long-off. This wasn't hit powerfully, so he thought there could be a two here, and he turned around instinctively, but Bravo was incredibly quick to get to the ball, and Venu sent Gibbs back. All too late. In fact Venu had come down half-way, and then changed his mind. Talk about selling your partner down the river
full, wide outside off, and driven towards sweeper-cover
full, swinging away, a bit, and Gibbs runs as he hits it to long-off
just short of a length, angling away, and a single for Venu straight away

a golden duck for Laxman! Not his game this, to make room and hit "ugly" shots. Laxman was always backing away here, Bravo slipped in the bouncer, Laxman, not in position to play the shot (yes Laxman not in position!) and top-edges it towards deep square leg
just outside off, Gibbs plays it towards extra cover for single

this is superb field placement, it was a nice shot, looking to hit the length ball over extra cover, and he does that, but the sweeper cover is straighter this time, and the ball goes straight down Dhawan's throat. This field placement could have a bit to do with the knwoledge that Rohit plays that shot really well
another slower ball, short of a length, Gibbs is on the front foot already, and pulls from there only for a single
keeper comes up, a length ball, straightens a touch, and beats an attempted loft shot
slower ball, Gibbs seems to have been beaten, but gets down to a knee, and drags it from outside off to midwicket. What a drag!
that's his fifty, just a dab towards long-off, well played Gibbs, started off as the anchor, is looking to turn into a pirate
tries a bouncer, but this doesn't rise too much, and Rohit pulls it off the front foot towards long leg
steps out again, does Gibbs, and ends up yorking himself, but manages to play it down to long-off
just short of length, around off stump, and played towards long-off
this one swung away - was it reverse? - full, and moved away late, Gibb s plays with an open face and gets an easy single to thirdman
and straight away a big shpout against his Mumbai and India team-mate, this one beat Rohit, but was pitched just outside leg
slow ball, 86ks, grips a bit, but Rohit stays back and plays it towards long-off for an easy single

Jaya has got Smith! he slowed it up this time, Smith went for the trademark slog-sweep, and missed, and Jaya was accurate enough to hit. Nonetheless a superb cameo by Smith, who was promoted up the order
this is hit hard at Jayasuriya, so hard that Jayasuriya doesn't even want to attempt a save
Gibbs is warming up, just freed his arms on these, this is not hit hard at all, he makes room to free the arms and hits wide of long-off
on the pads, hit hard, but can't beat midwicket
this is thrown up outside off, and swatted towards long-off boundary where Malings gets the sliding stop in
outside leg, Smith looks for the revrse and misses
this is too wide, a poor start, and Gibbs opens his face to play it between point and thirdman, what an over for Deccan
full, on the pads, smashed away towards  long-on
almost yorks Smith, and played back to bowler
oh welcome to bowling Mr Kulkarni, Smith has slog-swept this, a stright delivery, 126ks, it wasn't a crsiply clean hit either, but goes high and clears midwicket
steps out, frees his arms, but can't get the elevation and gets only a single to long-on
Not if he bowls like that to Gibbs, a loosener on the pads, half-swept, half-flicked over short short square boundary on on side
a silimilar delivery and SMith goes to left of deep backward square this time, and this time the fielder gets the dive in and saves the boundary
superb runnings, full, fired in on the pads, and Sith plays it to just to right of deep backward sqyare and scampers through for two
steps out, yorkers himself, and gets a single to long-on
Smith clears front leg and goes for a fullish delivery, but it's a bit to slow for the shot, and gets a single to long-on
half a shout, beat Gibbs with a doosra, but perhaps it pitched outside leg
flat fulltoss, Gibbs gets across to sweep, lucky to get bat on towards short fine
what a shot, this isn't too short, it's just outside off, and Smith stays back to cut it towards extra cover, and this speeds off on the fast outfield
thrown up, Gibbs gets a single to long-on
this time it is a touch slower, and he plays it a bit straighter and gets a single
another quick yorker, and again played straight to midwicket
Jaya is furious, darts in a leg-stump yorker, and Smith plays it straight to JP at midwicket
Smith slog-sweeps, and he slog-sweeps hard, over midwicket
a touch shorter than a leg-stump yorker, Smith stays back and balys it towards deep backward square
full, on the pads, and tunred away to square leg
short and wide, staightening again, and cut away just for single
flat topspinner, on the pads, Smith looks onside, but is beaten by the lack of spin, but the leading-edge doesn't carry
tossed up outside off, straighter one, and beats Smith
short on the pads, turned away to fine leg
he had him there, Gibbs looks over extra again, Jayasuriya is too straight for that again, the loft instead goes long-off, and falls just short
Gibbs steps down, looks to make room to go over extra, Jaya follows him - wily fox - and Gibbs doesn't get the timing
flat fulltoss, and played to long-on
short, a bit wide, and hit to wide of long-off for two
thrown up, around off, Smith knows he is not there to the pitch of it, and defends
full and straight, and nudged down the ground for a single

and times that superbly right away, takes half a step down the wicket, Bravo shortens tyhe length, but Smith pushes it through the off side, and beats the sweeper-cover. Short boundary + good timing = four runs

and he gets Gilchrist with the poorest delivery he has bowled so far, this would have been a wide outside off had Gilchrist not driven at it with all his might, but all he manages is a faint edge through to Pinal Shah
maybe not, even the bouncer can't keep Gibbs still, he stepped out again, Bravo bounced again, but Gibbs pulled it towards midwicket for a single
and a bouncer will keep Gibbs in, who stepped out early and had to sway out of the line
slower ball, and smart batting, he opens the face and takes a single to thirdman
Phew what a shot, length ball, on the pads, Gilchrist makes a half-move to front foot, and flicks it over wide long-on. It's gone way into the stand
tossed up again, on the stumps, and Gibbs defends it into the on side
this was a doosra, remarkably slower, 84ks, gets a thick outside edge, and it runs down to the thirdman boundary
Harbhajan repeats the mistake, same delivery, same shot, but this time the short thirdman gets across, and saves four
too fast, 96ks, and Gilchrist is too smart for these deliveries, this gave him room, and Gilchrist late-cuts it, thirdman is up, okay bye
pitched up, but still flat and fast, 98ks, and helped away into the on side
darted away, gets the line wrong, and angles it down the leg
it's flat, on the stumps, and Gibbs defends
Bravo tests Pinal Shah this time, sick of edges and mis-hits, he bowls a bouncer with the keeper up, it surprises both the batsmen and the keeper, and results in one bye
edged and four! another big swing, the ball nips back in, takes inside edge, and goes past the keeper
another mis-hit falls safe, just short of a length, within stumps, Gibbs stands tall and looks to loft it straight, and just clears Dhawan at mid-on, and gets two to show for it
this one slips down the leg side, and beats Gibbs with sharp movement in
just short of a length, pitches middle, holds its line, and Gibbs can't do much with it
almost a catch, Gilchrist swings at a length ball from his crease, and it goes one-bounce to Dhawan at mid-off. What's more, he misses a direct hit that would have got Gilchrist
just shor tof alength, and dropped into off side for a single

Zaheer almost had Gilchrist here, but the edge goes for a six! Oh come on some justice for bowlers? This one moved away, Gilchrist swung almightily, got a thick edge towards thirdman, and the ball cleared Malinga
that's cut him into two, Gilchrist has had a bit of trouble facing the away-going delivery, but this one jagged back into him, from a length, and it goes over the stumps
stays in the crease this time, angling across him, and Gibbs opens the face and takes a single
Gibbs has the dancing shoes for spikes, he steps down to Zaheer again, he adjusts his length and pulls it back, but Gibbs still flat-bats it down past mid-off
slipping onto the pads, and Gilchrist misses a flick, and gets a leg-bye
how is that a wide? this was short, Gilchrist went for the cut, is beaten by the extra bounce, this one passed over his bat, and was pretty close to the wide indicator
another slower ball, 119ks, on the stumps, just short of driving length, Gibbs does well to keep it along the ground
that's unfortunate, this one was full, swung away, and just about crossed the wide marker after beating Gibbs
fullish on the pads, and Gilchrist goes for the short, square boundary on the on side, but the flick goes along the ground, and the area is well covered

lovely shot, Malinga errs a little bit with this yorker, but the ball is still swinging away from Gilchrist, but Gilchrist stays back and just opens the face towards a vacant thirdman region. He knew the field really well
another slower one, a bit shorter this time, and Gibbs opens the face into the covers, and takes a quick single
lovely bowling, Gibbs tries to step out, looking to convert a yorker into a fulltoss. Gibbs anticipated right, it was a yorker, but a slower one, 125Ks, and Gibbs is beaten
Malinga gets the yorker in, fast, on off, not much Gibbs can do with it
this will wake him up, looks to pull, the ball hurries onto him, and the top-edge carries over slip
this one swings, away from Gilchrist, and is beaten on the drive. And Gilchrist finds it boring - he yawns after that
slower ball, 117k, pitched middle, angles across, and Gibbs opens the face
steps out again, tries the same shot, but mistimes and edges it towards mid-on
and Gibbs is off, steps out, gets to the pitch and lofts it over extra cover, what a shot
angles this one across, 134ks, Gibbs defends it off the back foot
slower ball now, good comeback by Malinga, just outside off, and defended into the off side

Gilchrist has had his sighter, and has now hit a blinder, this was neither full nor short, on the stumps, and he short-arms it - neither a pull nor a drive - over mid-on, and where he got the timing from to take it for a six we will never know
a length delivery, 138ks, coming in at a low trajectory, and Gilchrist defends with open face, he has been on target so far
short and sharp, 134Ks, but came on quicker, Gilchrist looked for the pull for a moment, but realised he was late into the shot, and played it towards point
short of a length, pitched middle and angled away, but not enough room for Gilchrist to push it
just short of a length, moving into Gilchrist a touch, on target, defended right out of the middle of the bat, a clear and loud no
Pinal Shah makes room, RP follows him, and he flicks it into the on side, and Deccan are celebrating, it's three wins in three for them
goes for the short one, Zaheer makes room, and flat-bats it straight over the bowler's head
and this is the game secured, slower ball, beats a swing from the batsman
and there RP gets his wicket, that surely has to be the game, it's a fulltoss, and Harbhajan's bat twirls in his hands as he gives it all his power, and the ball flies to long-on
can Harbhajan do it? his second six, sees the length ball, goes inside-out, clears Gibbs at long-off, his second six
and he nearly gets one, just back of a length, on the stumps, Zaheer makes room again, slices it towards third man, but lands safe
superb again, one can't do much with an off-stump yorker, Zaheer gets the best result possible, a single to cover
lovely bowling, saw Zaheer make room again, went wide of off this time, and beat him. What an over
slower ball, 127ks, surprises Harbhajan, and all he manages is to drag it to midwicket
Zaheer is looking to make room right away, Edwards follows him, 142ks, Zaheer manages to get it to long-off

and Edwards has turned it for Deccan, what a big wicket, this was full and straight, Bravo was caught in the crease, looking to get inside it and go leg side, but Edwards was too sharp for that and hit him right in front. Is this the game?
it's Edwards first, and what a yorker, on middle, Harbhajan makes room, gets inside half of the bat, and gets a single to mid-on
dot ball again, Venu gets his back, yorker.
oh Venu, fulltoss, and Bravo flicks it over midwicket again, where Harmeet (he is having a bad day), does well to get to the ball, but parries it into the boundary
dot ball! full, hit straight back to Venu
full, outside off, played to long-off
that Harbhajan bat is feeling good, fulltoss, and heaved over midwicket again, for a six this time
Bravo steps down, gets too close to pitch, and can't clear midwicket
slower and shorter this time, Bravo is early into the shot, and just manages to chip it over Edwards
finally that Caribbean flick from Bravo works, length ball, into the pads, and extravagant backlift, and then over midwicket. To his compatriot
bouncer this time, Harbhajan is expecting something fuller, but gets back up well, drops his wrists and gets a singel into the covers
that's a fast yorker, down the leg side, swinging further, Gilchrist does well to prevent it from going to boundary
Harbhajan is in, and Harbhajan is rocking, this is not a yorker, just a touch shorter, and Harbhajan loves that length, heaves it over midwicket

this is a day of the slingers, Edwards goes round the wicket, gets it full, almost a yorker, just outside off, Nayar goes for the big hit, and gets a thin edge through to Gilchrist. Deccan in front now
yorker straight away, outside off, Bravo inside-edges it to fine leg
full, on the pads, and Bravo flicks with his back leg in ther air
full, on off, Nayar is on a knee, and lofts it straight towards long-off where Smith does well to prevent the boundary
another hard hit, into the leg side, and into the gap, gets two for it
full, almost yorks Nayar
oh Nayar, that's huge, first boundary since the time-out, and this ball deserved no less than six, fulltoss on the pads, and flat-batted over midwicket
almost caught by Edwards, Bravo looks to clear extra cover, mis-hits, Edwards leaps high and to his right, but can't get his hand to it
overpitched, outside off, driven straight to sweeper-cover
fulltoss again, played down the ground and along the ground
angled into the pads, and played into the leg side

what a big wicket, Ojha has struck thrice in three overs, with a fulltoss this time, Duminy steps down, and lofts it over the leg-side field, it seems like it has gone between deep dquare and midwicket, but Smith runs fast from deep square, very fast, to surprise everybody. Superb catch, looked comfortable in the end
this one was slower, thrown up, enticing Bravo, who is beaten in flight as he goes for the big heave, is beaten, but is lucky to get the back leg to it
full, flat, 95ks, and played down to long-on
and another single for Duminy, this was full, and he played just to left of extra cover
fired into his pads, and he gets a single to long-on
good shot from Bravo, not too flashy, just opening the face a touch to hit it to wide of long-off
another single from Duminy down to long-off
angling down, and beats a flick from Bravo, but one leg-bye ensues
fulltoss from Venu, JP gets a single down to long-off
full, flat, on off stump,and turned away to midwicket
full, expansive flick through midwicket, Gavaskar likes it, "he has come down to give the ball some licks maan," he says
and right away he hits it through extra cover, no foot work, just a flow of the bat
smart bowling again, this one was slower than the earlier ones, flighted too, Dhawan looks to slog it, and misses it completely, the off stump is out
full, on the middle stump, and played down to long-on
Ojha gets away with that fulltoss on the pads, which is smashed into the leg side, but straight towards the sweeper
full, outside off, driven limply through the off side
short, just outside off, and Dhawan waits for it, but his cut shot can't beat the point
full, on stumps, and played to long-off
shortish, outside off, and played towards sweeper-cover
full, on the stumps, Dhawan sweeps, but can't beat short fine leg
just short of length, outside off, not turning, and helped towards thirdman
thrown up, within the stumps, defended into the leg side by Dhawan

and that's smart bowling again, almost a replay of the first ball, Tendulkar steps out, makes room to go over extra, but this is too full, and he ends up hitting it straight to Gibbs at extra cover. And once again, a wicket falls immediately after the time-out, and his timing has looked off right since the break
steps out, looks to make room, Ojha saw that, and bowled a full, flat delivery, and almost yorks Tendulkar
full and straight, and played down to long-on
outside off, sqaute to cut it, and this one falls just wide of short thirdman
and almost a return catch, Tendulkar looks for a paddle from outside off, gets a a leading edge, and it doesn't carry
another fulltoss, and turned away towards sqaure leg
full, on middle, Tendulkar looks for big sweep, but misses
shorter this time, but steered away from in front of stumps for one
and JP comes up with his straight six, lovely, as good as Sachin two overs ago, length ball, on stumps, within his swing, and he lofts it over sightscreen
yorker, on the stumps, and defended to bowler
thrown up, fulltoss infact, Duminy looks for a sweep, sees it's too wide, and then looks to glide, but misses
length ball, swinging away, and Duminy gets an easy single to long-off
slower ball, on the pads, and flicked away for one
back of a length, and steered to thirdman
overpitched outside off, and driven away to wide of sweeper-cover
full, on the pads, and turned away to short midwicket
inside-edged through Gilchrist's legs for four, it was short, angling away, went for the cut
shot, top shot, oh the Tendulkar of old, steps out, makes a bit of room, and lofts Ojha straight, damn straight, and high, lovely six
thrown up again, and this is just outside off, and played down to long-off
full again, into the pads, and played straight to short midwicket
full outside off, can't beat cover
slower, tossed up, Tendulkar beaten by the lack of spin, but gets a leg-bye
way down the leg side this one
full, outside off, and driven towards sweeper-cover
full, on off, and played down to long-off
gets away with a short and wide one, maybe it's the extra bounce that beats Duminy
angling in, beats the shot, but a leg-bye ensues
smart shot, gets across on a knee, is too close to the pitch, so can't scoop it, but laps it to square of short fine
on target, just short of length, on off, and Tendulkar plays towards Gibbs at point
short, angling away, and guided towards thirdman
gets too straight this time, and a touch too full, but the late swing beats Duminy's shot
and again, similar delivery, just outside off, angling in towards the stumps, and defneded with open face towards short thirdman
good comeback, length, just outside off, heading towards the stumps, and defended with open face and soft hands
thios is short on leg, and angles down
it's a length ball, on off, and Duminy takes half a step down, and lofts it over mid-on
NO-BALL!, short one too, and pulled away to sqaure leg
short, and a touch wide, moving away, Sachin looks to cut but pulls out because of the late movement
on the stumps, short of a length, Tendulkar doesn't have the room to run it down to thirdman

oh Harmeet Singh is being pasted, this was a length delivery again, no movement just angling across, and Duminy takes two steps down the wicket, and crashes it through the gap between mid-off and extra cover
shortish, angling across, Duminy looks to run it down, but misses
this is short and wide, and Tendulkar could have made it four boundary hits in this over, but can't beat the thirdman
smooth and easy, length ball, on stumps, Tendulkar stands up tall, lofts it over long-on. No power, just a clean swing
drivable length, on the stumps, Tendulkar steps down, makes room, and hits over a flying cover - Smith. It was close but easy four, Tendulkar is picking on his man
and it flies for four, short and wide, 120ks, Tendulkar waits, makes his own pace, and hits it over cover, as opposed to square, good improvisation
no missing this time, JP's IPL has started, walked across to a full and straight delivery, and flicked it over the shart square-leg boundary, bit hit
short, just outside off, JP looks onside, but misses it by a long distance
full and stright, Tendulkar goes across to get inside the line, and turns it into the leg side
full, on the middle, and swinging down the leg, JP is beaten by the swing, but gets a leg-bye
this was short, on the off stump, and Tendulkar pushes it into the off side
Tendulkar misses out, this was short and wide, and it was cut just to the right of Venugopal at thirdman, where a fumble allows them to take a two
good sharp bouncer, and Tendulkar moves across, stands tall, and plays it down into the on side
just short of a length, on the pads, and turned away towards fine leg
slower ball, on the pads, Duminy is early into the shot, and has to play around his front pad, and can't beat square leg inside the circle
that's gone horribly wrong and down the leg side
looks for a bouncer, angling across, but the ball doesn't bounce much; at any rate JP had made his mind up to leave it
super shot, it is just a push to a delivery just short of length, but the fall flies to the right of point, it was just a defensive push, and it beat thirdman Harmeet who dived, and got a hand to it
goes for the yorker this time, falls just short of one, but Duminy is too new to hit it, and defends it to mid-off
that's close, uff that's close, this was just short, pitched off, cut away, Duminy let it go, but it cut too much
tries the bouncer, doesn't rise too high, but Tendulkar lets it go

Oh that was close, big shout, slower fulltoss, and Tendulkar plays all around it, but the replays show it hit him just outside leg, top call from Simon Taufel, it's too easy to get swayed by a fulltoss

RP's golden arm works, perhaps the wrong shot from Jayasuriya, a slow start has frustrated him, and he looks to pull a delivery that is not short enough. It bounces a bit on him, too, and gets a top-edge that flies high, and the purple cap fits for RP
fuller, wide still, and there isn't much swing there, but Jayasuriya misses out again and plays it straight to cover
short and wide, and Jayasuriya looks for his aerial cut, but is a touch early into the shot. How lucky RP is
length ball, on the stumps, straightening a touch, Tendulkar plays towards mid-off with soft hands and gets a single
slower delivery, 124ks, stump to stump, and Jayasuriya defends it back to the bowler. Good start by Edwards
just short of a length, just outside off, Tendulkar looks for the cut, and gets an inside edge towards sqaure leg
slower ball, grips away from Jaya on a length, Jaya drops it into the off side, and calls Sachin through. Smith was really quick coming in from cover, but Tendulkar was quicker
this is straighter, and faster, 143ks, Jayasuriya looks for his trademark short-arm flick off the pads, but is beaten by the pace
lovely bowling, just fuller than good length, draws Jaya in, and then moves away, beats the edge, at
goes for the bouncer, it's fast, 140ks, but it's too high
accurate, fat, 143ks, and defended to mid-off
